> ⚠️ **Security & Privacy:** If this bug involves sensitive data, private code, or is a security vulnerability, please do NOT open a public issue. Email us directly at **<security@oclka.dev>** (or check SECURITY.md).
>
> 💡 **Multiple issues?** Open one issue per bug. If issues are related and in the same file, you may group them in a single report using `### ISSUE-1`, `### ISSUE-2` sub-headers.
